content: This paper presents a novel method for joint feature selection and classification of longitudinal (functional) data with categorical responses, combining logistic loss with functional principal components and an adaptive Dual Augmented Lagrangian algorithm to efficiently handle high-dimensional datasets. The approach is validated through simulations and a real-world application examining links between chronic diseases and health/socio-demographic factors, demonstrating its computational efficiency and effectiveness.
